title: Karbala ke ban mein
body:
karbala ke ban mein koi khafila loota gaya
ay azeezo khandane mustufa loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
hoti hai maa ko tamanna naujawan dulha bane
umme laila ka wo armaan bekhata loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema ki betiyon ka aasra abbas thay
zainab o kulsoom ka wo aasra loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
asre ashoora ko do bache atash se mar gaye
nehr par pyason ke dil ka muddua loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
gyarveen shab roshni dekhi to zainab ne kaha
zaalimo lootoge ab kya ghar bhara loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
boli sughra bibiyon ki godiyon ko dekh kar
bibiyon nanha sa wo ghuncha bhi kya loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
ya khuda loota na jaye koi kunba is tarha
jis tarha zehra ka kunba ja-baja loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke zindan mein aakar margayi binte hussain
maa phupi behno ke dil ka aasra loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
<<DIVIDER>>
hulle jannat ke khuda ne bheje jinke waaste
pairahan tak us shahe mazloom ka loota gaya
karbala ke ban mein…
